description: Find the most likely professional/work email address for a specific person at a domain on Hunter.io. Returns the email, a confidence score, position, and the number of corroborating sources. Example: email_finder({ domain: "stripe.com", first_name: "Patrick", last_name: "Collison" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Hunter.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: email_finder
